intro.h2: A family cabinet shop that builds every piece
paragraphs: Swing Cabinets, LLC builds custom cabinets in Shelbyville, TN from its shop on Pinkston Rd. It is a family-owned business, and the Facebook page says it has spent 25 years building for family and friends around town. Kitchens are the main work, along with bathroom vanities, mantels, bookshelves and entertainment centers.

Customers talk about quality first. One reviewer says the shop takes pride in each piece with a huge focus on detail, and that the workmanship speaks for itself. Another says several of his relatives are just as happy with their cabinets. The shop also handles the countertops: granite, quartz, marble, solid surface or laminate.

services.h2: Custom cabinets in Shelbyville, TN, with countertops to match

items.name: Custom kitchen cabinets
items.blurb: Cabinets built to fit your kitchen rather than picked from a catalog, in painted, glazed or stained finishes. Their kitchens range from cream glazed cabinets with a dark island to rich cherry-toned cabinets around a butcher-block topped island.

image.alt: Kitchen with cherry-stained custom cabinets, tile backsplash and an island with a butcher-block top and stools

items.name: Kitchen remodels
items.blurb: Swing Cabinets takes on full kitchen remodels, not just boxes. Their photos show new cabinet layouts with tall pantry units, stacked uppers with glass doors, built-in wall ovens and large islands with seating, finished with under-cabinet lighting.

image.alt: Remodeled kitchen with cream glazed cabinets to the ceiling, double wall ovens and a dark stained island with stools

items.name: Countertops
items.blurb: The business card says it plainly: custom cabinets and counter tops. Choose granite, quartz, marble, solid surface or laminate, and the cabinets and counters are planned together. Photos show speckled granite paired with dark espresso cabinets and a glass mosaic backsplash.

image.alt: Dark espresso cabinets with speckled granite countertops, glass mosaic backsplash and stainless range

items.name: Vanities, mantels and built-ins
items.blurb: Beyond the kitchen, the shop builds bathroom vanities, fireplace mantels, bookshelves and bookcases, and entertainment centers. If it is made of wood and needs to fit a particular wall in your house, ask about it when you call for your free estimate.

about.h2: A family business on Pinkston Road
about.text: Swing Cabinets, LLC is a family-owned cabinet maker at 331 Pinkston Rd in Shelbyville, Tennessee. Its Facebook page, Swing's Custom Cabinets, invites customers to share photos of anything the shop has built for family and friends over 25 years of business. The owner's daughter once shared how her dad rescued and fixed up an old family table and chairs that were headed for the dump, which says a lot about the care that goes into the work. The shop also sponsors local youth baseball teams and shows up every year to support the players.

image.alt: Wide view of a white custom kitchen by Swing Cabinets with wall ovens, glass-front uppers and an island

service_area.text: Swing Cabinets, LLC works from 331 Pinkston Rd in Shelbyville, Tennessee, and has built cabinets for families and friends around town for 25 years. Its Facebook page is listed in Shelbyville, and it sponsors local youth baseball teams there. If you live outside Shelbyville and want to know whether the shop can build and install for you, call the office at (931) 684-3576 and ask.

items.a: Yes. Free estimates are printed right on the Swing Cabinets business card. Call the office at (931) 684-3576 to set one up for your kitchen, bathroom vanity, mantel, bookshelves or entertainment center, and have rough room measurements ready if you can.

The business card lists laminate, solid surface, and granite and quartz, and the Facebook page adds marble. Because the shop builds the cabinets too, the tops and boxes are planned together. Photos show speckled granite over dark espresso cabinets and on painted islands.

items.q: What else do you build besides kitchens?
items.a: Bathroom vanities, mantels, bookshelves and bookcases, and entertainment centers, along with full kitchen remodels. If you have a built-in in mind that is not on that list, call and describe it; the shop builds custom pieces, not stock sizes, so each piece is sized to your space.

Google lists Monday to Thursday, 6 AM to 4:30 PM, and Friday, 6 AM to 3:30 PM. The shop is closed Saturday and Sunday. The office line is (931) 684-3576, and you can also email wright9544@yahoo.com with photos or measurements of your room at any time.

Swing Cabinets, LLC is at 331 Pinkston Rd, Shelbyville, TN 37160. Call (931) 684-3576 before stopping by so someone is free to talk about your project, and bring photos, rough measurements or a sketch of the room if you have them.
